Upload a large file successfully

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateFileRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\CreateFileRequest::from_json(json_encode(["file" => "eyJwcm9tcHQiOiAibGFyZ2UgdHJhaW5pbmcgZGF0YSJ9Cg==", "filename" => "large_training_data.jsonl", "purpose" => "fine-tune"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->createFile($req);
var_dump($result->id);
```
